text.tspan: S5 Burn-wire drivers and deployed-state sense
SQSO-HW-DIAG-001 · preliminary · dashed = part not selected (TBD) · TBR = value not confirmed
Sources: software/rust/firmware/src/gpio.rs (PB9-PB12, PA1); hardware/rf/ANTENNA_DESIGN.md; docs/BASELINE_PARAMETERS.md 4 (timers, inhibits); W7
One burn line for the two antennas (finding F4): two resistors in parallel on one driver.
Two series switches in the deploy path: SW6 (DEPLOY_EN, high side) and Q (low side),
after DS1/DS2 and the 30-minute timer (CDS 2.4.4); a third deployable inhibit is TBD (F5).
5 Ohm on 14.4 V draws about 2.9 A per resistor: the drive must limit it to 0.5-1 A
(PWM on PB9 TIM4_CH4 / PB10 TIM2_CH3, or a linear limit; finding F7, TBR).
so the software retries the burn (fail-safe side).
